plan.models: Existing MoE/simple plus each of 8 listwise trials selected by fusion-only and residual diagnostic development metrics.
plan.selection: Maximum dev MRR@12, then Hit@3, then prefer smaller alpha. Dev was used for candidate training selection too; no unbiased test claim.

no_test_claim: These are development-selected results on weak source-derived queries. An independent verified test is still needed.
